nodes.description: Public address state variable holding the contract owner, set to msg.sender in the constructor and used by the onlyOwner modifier.
Public uint state variable used as the incrementing primary key for user_details entries and incremented in setUser.
Public mapping(uint=>Bank) storing all deposit records (user, cycle, rate, amount, interest, state) keyed by id.
Mapping(uint=>uint) holding the per-asset interest rates for AGCoin, ETH, BTC, LTC, XRP and USD, written by setRate.
Constructor that sets owner = msg.sender, initialises id = 1 and emits the deployed event.
Public function that creates a Bank record for msg.sender under the current id, reads rate[_v_asset] and increments the id counter.
onlyOwner public function that writes the six asset rates into the rate mapping and emits the rates event.
onlyOwner public function that computes interest for a given id, marks the record mature and records the withdrawal asset and state.
onlyOwner public function that recomputes and stores the interest for a given id using rate*cycle*amount/(100*12).
Caller-supplied address used for owner assignment, ownership checks and as the deposit owner in setUser.
Unchecked arithmetic _rate*cycle*amount/(100*12) inside withdraw that can overflow or be manipulated through stored rate, cycle and amount values.
Unchecked arithmetic _rate*cycle*amount/(100*12) inside cal_intrest that can overflow given attacker-influenced rate, cycle and amount.
Unchecked increment id += 1 in setUser, which can silently wrap on overflow and reuse an existing record key.
Deposit duration in months supplied to setUser, stored in user_details[id].cycle and later used in interest maths.
Deposit value in USD supplied to setUser, validated to be at least 100 and stored in the Bank record.
Enum BankAsssetType asset selector supplied to setUser and used to index the rate mapping.
Deposit amount in actual currency supplied to setUser, stored and later used in interest calculations.
Record identifier supplied to withdraw, used to index user_details without validating ownership of the record.
Enum BankAsssetType indicating the asset requested on withdrawal, written into user_details[_id].withdrawl.
Record identifier supplied to cal_intrest, used to index user_details without validating record existence.
AGCoin interest rate value supplied to the onlyOwner setRate function.
ETH interest rate value supplied to the onlyOwner setRate function.
BTC interest rate value supplied to the onlyOwner setRate function.
LTC interest rate value supplied to the onlyOwner setRate function.
XRP interest rate value supplied to the onlyOwner setRate function.
USD interest rate value supplied to the onlyOwner setRate function.
Local variable in setUser caching rate[uint(_v_asset)] before it is written into the Bank record.
Local variable in withdraw caching user_details[_id].rate for the interest computation.
Local variable in cal_intrest caching user_details[_id].rate for the interest computation.

edges.reason: Constructor assigns the privileged owner state variable directly from the untrusted msg.sender.
onlyOwner modifier gates setRate on msg.sender == owner, so the caller fully controls whether the guarded state write executes.
onlyOwner modifier gates withdraw on msg.sender == owner, making the caller address the sole authorization condition.
onlyOwner modifier gates cal_intrest on msg.sender == owner, making the caller address the sole authorization condition.
msg.sender is stored as the owner of the newly created Bank record in user_details[id].user.
Parameter _cycle flows into setUser and is persisted and later used in interest maths.
Parameter _asset_value_USD flows into setUser after the >=100 check.
Parameter _v_asset flows into setUser and selects the asset type stored in the record.
Parameter _amount flows into setUser and is stored in the Bank record.
_v_asset indexes the rate mapping, so the supplied enum value selects which stored rate is read.
rate[uint(_v_asset)] is read from the rate mapping into the local _rate variable of setUser.
Local _rate is written back into user_details[id].rate by setUser.
setUser writes user, cycle, asset value, asset type, state, rate, amount, withdrawal asset and withdrawal state into user_details[id].
setUser reads the current id as the record key and writes the incremented value back to the id state variable.
The current id state variable is the operand of the unchecked id += 1 increment.
setUser performs an unchecked integer increment of the id counter, which can silently wrap and collide with existing records.
agcoin_rate parameter is written into rate[uint(BankAsssetType.AGCoin)] by setRate.
eth_rate parameter is written into rate[uint(BankAsssetType.ETH)] by setRate.
btc_rate parameter is written into rate[uint(BankAsssetType.BTC)] by setRate.
ltc_rate parameter is written into rate[uint(BankAsssetType.LTC)] by setRate.
xrp_rate parameter is written into rate[uint(BankAsssetType.XRP)] by setRate.
usd_rate parameter is written into rate[uint(BankAsssetType.USD)] by setRate.
setRate mutates the rate mapping state variable for all six supported assets.
Parameter _id selects the user_details record read and mutated by withdraw.
Parameter withdrawAsset is written into user_details[_id].withdrawl by withdraw.
withdraw writes interest, v_state, withdrawl and withdrawState into the user_details mapping.
user_details[_id].rate is read into the local _rate variable in withdraw.
The cached rate feeds the unchecked expression _rate*cycle*amount/(100*12) that can overflow.
cycle and amount read from user_details[_id] are multiplied together with the rate without overflow protection.
withdraw executes the unchecked interest multiplication and division over stored rate, cycle and amount.
Parameter _id selects the user_details record read and mutated by cal_intrest.
cal_intrest writes the recomputed interest into user_details[_id].intrest.
user_details[_id].rate is read into the local _rate variable in cal_intrest.
The cached rate feeds the unchecked expression _rate*cycle*amount/(100*12) that can overflow.
cycle and amount read from user_details[_id] are multiplied with the rate without overflow protection.
cal_intrest executes the unchecked interest multiplication and division over stored rate, cycle and amount.
